about.text: Redefining streetwear with refined elegance and uncompromising quality

KRUX was born from a vision to bridge the gap between urban streetwear and refined elegance. What began as a small atelier in Brooklyn has grown into a brand recognized for its commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and timeless design.

Our founder, Marcus Chen, envisioned a brand that would honor the authenticity of street culture while embracing the sophistication of luxury fashion. Today, KRUX continues to push boundaries, creating pieces that are as functional as they are beautiful.
"Fashion should feel effortless. Every piece we create is designed to be worn, lived in, and loved for years to come." — Marcus Chen, Founder
We source only the finest materials from ethical suppliers. Every garment undergoes rigorous quality checks before reaching your hands.
Each piece is crafted with precision by skilled artisans who take pride in their work, ensuring exceptional attention to detail.
We're committed to reducing our environmental impact through sustainable materials and ethical manufacturing processes.
To create timeless streetwear that empowers individuals to express themselves authentically, while championing sustainability and craftsmanship in everything we do.

Every KRUX garment begins with a vision. Our designers sketch, prototype, and refine each piece until it meets our exacting standards. From there, our skilled artisans bring these designs to life using time-honored techniques.

We believe that true quality is found in the details. That's why we obsess over every stitch, every seam, and every finish. The result is clothing that not only looks exceptional but stands the test of time.
KRUX is founded in Brooklyn, New York, with a small collection of 12 pieces and a commitment to quality over quantity.
We open our first flagship store in SoHo, creating a space where customers can experience the brand's aesthetic firsthand.
We transition to 95% sustainable materials across our entire collection, reinforcing our commitment to the planet.
KRUX gains international recognition, with our collections featured in leading fashion publications worldwide.
We continue to innovate, expanding our sustainable practices and reaching new communities around the globe.
With a background in architecture and fashion, Marcus brings a unique perspective to design, blending structural elements with fluid silhouettes.
Elena leads our design team with a passion for minimalism and functionality, ensuring every piece serves a purpose while looking effortless.
Sarah spearheads our sustainability initiatives, working with suppliers and manufacturers to reduce our environmental footprint.
David oversees our production process, ensuring quality standards are met and that our artisans have the resources they need.
We believe that great design is timeless, and true quality is measured not by seasons, but by years. Every piece we create is an investment in your personal style and our shared future.

contact.text: We'd love to hear from you. Reach out with any questions or feedback.
What are your shipping options and delivery times?

We offer free standard shipping on all orders within the US. Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping (2-3 business days) is available for $15. International shipping rates vary by location and take 7-14 business days.
What is your return and exchange policy?

We accept returns within 30 days of purchase. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and with original tags attached. Returns are free for domestic orders. Exchanges can be processed through our returns portal. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.
How do I determine my size?

We provide detailed size charts on each product page. For the most accurate fit, we recommend measuring a similar item you own and comparing it to our size guide. If you're between sizes, we suggest sizing up for a relaxed fit. Our customer service team is also available to assist with sizing questions.

Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping rates are calculated at checkout based on destination. Please note that international orders may be subject to customs duties and taxes, which are the responsibility of the customer. Delivery times vary by location but typically range from 7-14 business days.
How do I care for my KRUX garments?

To maintain the quality of your KRUX pieces, we recommend machine washing cold with like colors and tumble drying low. For items with technical finishes, air drying is preferred. Avoid using bleach or fabric softeners. Each product also includes specific care instructions on the label.

product-details.text: Premium technical hoodie crafted from organic cotton blend. Features a relaxed fit, adjustable hood, and subtle branding. Perfect for everyday wear with refined streetwear aesthetic.
Premium technical hoodie crafted from organic cotton blend. Features a relaxed fit, adjustable hood, and subtle branding. Perfect for everyday wear with refined streetwear aesthetic.

The Ash Technical Hoodie represents the perfect balance between urban functionality and refined aesthetics. Constructed from a premium organic cotton blend with technical properties, this hoodie offers exceptional comfort while maintaining a sophisticated silhouette.

Features include a double-layered hood with adjustable drawcords, ribbed cuffs and hem for a secure fit, and subtle embroidered branding at the chest. The fabric is treated for water resistance while remaining breathable, making it ideal for transitional weather.
